description: The Arco Vara 55th Run Around Lake Harku is a traditional 6.5 km race taking place on May 30, 2026, on the shores of Lake Harku. The race is part of the 2026 Maru Lake Runs series and is its second event. The course features water stations and is marked and secured by a route management team. In addition to runners, Nordic walkers and walkers are also welcome, starting in the last group. The race center is located at the start-finish area, where bib numbers are issued and awards are presented.
course_highlights: 6.5 km loop around Lake Harku
Water stations at 3 km and at the finish
Route management and marked course
additional: Race bibs will be issued on race day from 9:30 to 11:30 at Lake Harku. Timing is via a chip attached to the back of the bib. Participants will receive a medal, sports drink, and water on the course and at the finish, as well as medical assistance throughout the course. Awards ceremony is scheduled around 13:00, where the top 6 men and women and age group winners will be recognized. The race features two distances and children's runs, with registration starting at 9:30 and the start at 12:00. Participants can enjoy nature and a healthy lifestyle.

name: Koeru kergejõustikuvõistlused
location: Koeru KK staadion, Koeru, Järva County, Estonia
description: Koeru Athletics Competition is a traditional athletics event held at the Koeru KK stadium. Men and women participate in two age groups and compete in several disciplines, including 100 meters, long jump, shot put, discus throw, javelin throw, and 1000 meters. The winner is determined by the total points from the top three disciplines. The competition is open to everyone and offers the opportunity to participate in all events, where young athletes use implements appropriate for their age group.
course_highlights: Event disciplines: 100 meters, long jump, shot put, discus throw, javelin throw, 1000 meters
Four attempts in long jump and throws
The competition takes place at Koeru KK stadium
additional: In the men's and women's categories, the triathlon winner is awarded a trophy, and the 2nd to 6th place receive medals. Winners of individual disciplines are awarded medals. Young athletes use implements suitable for their age group. The event will be held on May 30, 2026, at Koeru sports track, where participants can accumulate points across multiple disciplines, and winners will be awarded trophies and medals.

name: Maardu kevadjooks
description: Maardu Spring Run and Health Walk is a traditional sports day held in Maardu, bringing together movement enthusiasts of all ages. The event features several runs and health walks for different age groups and abilities, including children's runs, youth runs, a walk for people with special needs, and 3 and 5-kilometer runs. Participation is free, and every finisher receives a medal. The aim of the event is to offer the joy of movement, a good feeling, and an active day outdoors, emphasizing quality time spent with family and friends.
course_highlights: Multiple distances: 100 m children's run, 1 km youth run, 500 m walk for people with special needs, 3 km and 5 km runs
Health walk over a 3 km distance
Starts and activities next to Maxima XX shopping center on the main stage
additional: Participation is free. Registration is open until May 29 at 19:00 online or at Maardu City Stadium from May 14 to 29 between 13:00 and 17:00. On the day of the Spring Run, on-site registration is only available for the 500 m walk for people with special needs. All finishers receive a medal. The day concludes with a lottery among participants. On race day, registration and awards will take place at the finish line. The event includes various running and walking distances and is aimed at the whole family.

name: jooks ümber Harku järve

price_tiers.distance: Arco Vara 55. jooks ümber Harku järve 6,5 km

description: The Arco Vara 55th Run Around Lake Harku takes place on May 30, 2026, at the shores of Lake Harku in Tallinn. It is a 6.5 km run that is part of the 2026 Maru Lake Runs series and is the second event in this series. In addition to runners, Nordic walkers and walkers are also welcome, starting in the last group. The course features water stations, and the race center offers, in addition to the run, a children's athletics workshop and pop-up shops. Participants will receive a medal, chip timing, sports drink and water on the course, and awards.
course_highlights: 6.5 km loop around Lake Harku
Water stations at 3 km and at the finish
Course signage and marked route
additional: Race numbers will be issued on the day of the event from 9:30 AM to 11:30 AM at the shores of Lake Harku. Timing is chip-based, attached to the back of the bib. Participants are guaranteed a medal, sports drink, and water on the course and at the finish, as well as medical assistance and awards at 1:00 PM. Nordic walkers start after the runners in the last starting group. The event day includes children's races, awards, raffles, and additional activities such as a ski jump and sports equipment sales. Registration is open until May 20, 2026.

name: Läänemaa sörgib ühissörk
description: Lääne County running event is a lively and peaceful family gathering taking place on May 31 at the Haapsalu railway station. The group run is approximately 3+ kilometers long at a relaxed pace (~7:30 min/km), inviting all sports enthusiasts from Lääne County to participate. The event is the final part of a campaign that connects various runs held throughout May across the county. Both returning participants and newcomers are welcome to enjoy movement together and strengthen community spirit.
course_highlights: Start at Haapsalu railway station
Relaxed pace about 7:30 min/km
Distance approximately 3+ km
additional: The group run is part of a broader movement campaign taking place in different parts of Lääne County during May. The event is intended for all sports enthusiasts to enjoy movement together and strengthen community spirit. The pace is relaxed, suitable for a family event. Both youth and adults participate, emphasizing healthy lifestyles and community involvement. Specific registration and participation conditions have not been publicly published.

name: Meie oma maijooks 2026
description: Our own Maijooks 2026 is a traditional running race held on June 1 at the Kolga-Jaani school stadium and sports grounds. The event features various distances and age categories suitable for runners of all ages, Nordic walkers, and fitness enthusiasts. The aim of the event is to promote a healthy lifestyle, provide opportunities for competition, and value family-centered communal activities in the Kolga-Jaani area. Participants can enjoy a pleasant evening run on the bike path and stadium, and receive recognition for the best runners and regional representatives.
course_highlights: Children's runs around the stadium track for those up to 7 years old
1.5 km youth run on the bike path
4.5 km main run from and around Kolga-Jaani stadium
additional: The race includes children's runs for those up to 7 years old without timing, a 1.5 km youth run, and a 4.5 km main run. Nordic walkers can participate in the main run. Participation fee and bib distribution take place at the registration desk on race day. Awards are given to the top three in the youth and main runs, as well as to the best regional participants with special prizes. The races are held at the stadium and sports grounds; registration is required; free for children born in 2010 or later.

name: Virtuaaljooks suvi 2026
description: Virtual Run Summer 2026 is a flexible remote running race that allows participants to complete the chosen distance at a convenient time in their hometown. The race includes various distance options, including 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon (21 km), and also offers the opportunity to participate in a children's run. Participants can save and upload their results to the GoAndRun.eu portal, ensuring result reliability and comparison with other participants worldwide. Virtual running provides an environmentally friendly and convenient way to participate in sports without having to go to a physical location.
course_highlights: Virtual running race that can be completed in your hometown
Distance options of 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km half marathon
Results can be saved and uploaded from sports watches and app files
additional: Participants can upload results from common sports watch and app files (.fit, .gpx, .tcx, .pwx) or enter results manually. The race supports 'fair play' rules and allows results to be published anonymously or privately. Virtual running makes participation in sports events accessible to everyone, even in the face of unexpected obstacles. Registration and participation are conducted online, and the event is open to all running enthusiasts and supports Estonian veterans philanthropically.

name: Kambja Tervisejooksud
description: Kambja Health Runs are a traditional running series event that started in 2016 and will take place in 2026 over three stages. The runs are held on Kambja health trails, offering participants the opportunity to enjoy forest paths and some asphalt segments. The goal of the series is to promote healthy lifestyles and motivate people to engage in health running. Each stage features a 10 km race, as well as a health run and a power run, which use a formula based on body weight and elevation gain to determine the winner. All runners who participate in all three stages receive a series shirt, and the main winners are awarded a Merida Big Nine 20 bicycle.
course_highlights: Runs take place on Kambja health trails, mainly forest paths
10 km competitive run consists of one or two 5 km laps
Power run uses a formula based on body weight and elevation gain to determine the winner
additional: Start is open on the event day from 18:00 to 20:00, the 10 km race starts at 18:00 at each stage, and the finish line closes at 21:00. Timing is electronic. Registration is free and available online at regama.ee/kambja or on-site at the event center. The top three finishers in the race are awarded medals or trophies. Three stages, registration online or on-site, part of the Tartu County running and walking series.

name: Lääne-Virumaa noorte MV
description: Lääne-Virumaa Youth Athletics Championship is an athletics competition for young people and adults held in Rakvere. The competition includes various athletics disciplines such as running, jumping, and throwing, and is intended for different age groups from U-14 to adults. The aim of the event is to honor the memory of Eerik Konist and to popularize athletics among youth. All age groups are awarded medals, and the best performers receive special prizes. The competition takes place at the Heino Lipp Stadium in Rakvere and starts at 11:00 AM, with registration opening at 10:00 AM.
course_highlights: Diverse athletics disciplines: running, jumping, throwing
Age groups from U-14 to adults
Events held at Heino Lipp Stadium in Rakvere
additional: Registration begins at 10:00 AM and technical check-in must be submitted half an hour before the start of the competition. All disciplines include 4 attempts in jumps, throws, and shot put. The top three in each age group are awarded, with special prizes for the best boy and girl performances. The event starts with registration at 10:00 AM and competitions begin at 11:00 AM. Participants can enjoy sports and friendly competition, with medals and special prizes awarded to the best performers.

name: Filter Temposari (3. etapp)
location: Vabaduse väljak, Tallinn, Harju County, Estonia
description: Filter Temposari is Estonia's oldest and most prestigious tempo series, offering the opportunity to challenge yourself in cycling, running, or roller skating. The series stages take place in various locations around Tallinn and its surroundings, providing time-trial speed competitions. The Tallinn stage is held at Freedom Square, where the course is short and technical, well-suited for sprint enthusiasts. Finishers of the series receive a prize program called Kullapada, which rewards consistent participation in all stages.
course_highlights: Time-trial cycling on a speed track around Tallinn
Short 1.3 km sprints in the heart of Tallinn at Freedom Square
Roller skating on good surface roads on city streets
additional: The stage features a hot group, which is invited by name for the last 10 minutes. Warm-up during the race is prohibited, but free warm-up suits are available at the race center. Participants must follow traffic laws, as most of the course is not closed to cars. Finishers of the series are eligible for the Kullapada prize program, which rewards everyone who completes all season stages. The event includes various terrains and offers registration options as well as multiple distance categories, including 1.3 km and up to 5 km courses.

name: Kohila pikamaajooksude sari 2026 IV etapp 400m
location: Kohila Spordikeskuse staadion, Kohila, Rapla County, Estonia

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Stardimaks 8 eurot, kuni 19a ja pensionärid 5 eurot

description: The Kohila Long-Distance Running Series 2026, Stage IV, 400m, takes place at the Kohila Sports Center stadium and is open to all running enthusiasts. The series features different distances and age groups, where participants earn points based on their placement in each race. The starting fee is 8 euros, 5 euros for youth and pensioners, payable in cash on site. Pre-registration is recommended and closes at 4:30 PM on the day of the event; late registrants will be placed in the back heats. The winners of the series will be determined by age groups, and awards will be presented at the end of the series.
course_highlights: 400m long running track at the stadium
Races take place on the tarmac track of the Kohila Sports Center
The series includes various age groups and distances from 400m to 5000m
additional: Pre-registration ends at 4:30 PM on the day of the event; late registrants will be placed in the back heats. On-site registration closes at 6:30 PM. Races start with the faster heats. In each race, the top 10 receive points; the series standings are based on the best 6 races. Awards are given after the last race. To qualify for a prize, participants must take part in at least four stages. The starting fee is paid in cash on site; pre-registration is available on the website; the competitions are held at the Kohila stadium; there are age categories and a points system.

name: 5. ETAPP - Merimets
location: Pelguranna and Stroomi beach parking lots, Tallinn, Harju County, Estonia
description: Stage 5 - Merimetsa is part of the 24th Health Run and Walk series, which takes place in the parking lots of Pelguranna and Stroomi beach. This 3.6 km long stage offers participants the opportunity to enjoy beautiful nature and health trails in a seaside area. The event is suitable for both runners and walkers who want to spend active time and improve their health. The series stages take place in different parts of Tallinn, offering diverse landscapes and views.
course_highlights: 3.6 km long route in the Merimetsa area
Proximity to Pelguranna and Stroomi beach parking lots
Seaside and scenic landscape
additional: The event is part of a broader health journey that includes various running and walking events and is aimed at health-conscious participants across Estonia.

name: Kohila Pikamaajooksusari
description: The Kohila Long-Distance Running Series is a sports series in Kohila Parish consisting of several stages and aimed at local sports enthusiasts. The goal of the series is to promote sports and physical activity and to offer participants the opportunity to compete in various distances. At each stage, participants receive a beautiful commemorative medal, and overall points are tallied across the series in different competition categories. The series is organized by Kohila Sports Center, which supports a healthy lifestyle and active movement.
course_highlights: Multi-stage long-distance running series in Kohila Parish
Point scoring and commemorative medal for each stage finisher
Suitable for runners of different levels
additional: The series includes several stages at different distances, such as 800m, 2000m, 5000m. All participants receive a commemorative medal at each stage. It is recommended to undergo health tests before competitions. The events mainly take place in the evening, for example at 19:00. The series also features 800-meter runs, and participants can accumulate points throughout the season. The event is open to all age groups and offers a sports opportunity in a community-supportive environment.

name: Filter Temposari
description: Filter Temposari is Estonia's oldest and most prestigious tempo series, offering participants the chance to challenge themselves in cycling, running, or roller skating. The series consists of six events around Tallinn, featuring time-trial races where participants can accurately measure their form. A unique aspect of the series is the paired start at the Kiili stage and the prize program Kullapada, which recognizes consistent participation. The races are usually held on Wednesday evenings, with fast and short courses suitable for sprint enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Time-trial cycling, paired start allowed at the Kiili stage
Fast short sprints in running (3-6 km) and roller skating
Course on roads around Tallinn, partially open to traffic, safety is important
additional: The Hot Group: the last 10 minutes of the stage are reserved for the best cyclists. Warming up on the track during the race is prohibited; warm-up pants are available free of charge at the race center. Traffic is regulated on the race routes, but most of the course is not closed to cars; participants must follow traffic laws and stay on the right side of the roadway. The Kullapada prize program rewards consistent participation in all stages. Several stages and participant categories, prizes and medals, detailed schedule, and registration are available on the website. The event takes place on Wednesday evenings and includes various distance options.

name: KEVEK ja Tartu Kalev staadionijooksu sari
description: The KEVEK and Tartu Kalev Stadium Run series is an athletics stadium running series organized by Tartu Sports Club Kalev, offering participation opportunities at multiple stages at Tartu and Ülenurme stadiums. The aim of the series is to provide competition opportunities for children and youth and to promote athletics in the city and county of Tartu. The competitions take place during the summer months and are open to different age groups. Registration closes at 12:00 on the day of the competition, allowing flexible participation.
course_highlights: Competitions are held at Tartu Tamme and Ülenurme stadiums
The series includes several stages during the summer, including stages on June 6 and July 8
Suitable for children and youth to engage in athletics
additional: Stages 6 and 7 will be held at Ülenurme stadium due to track surface renovation. Registration closes at 12:00 on the competition day. Madsa Sports and Recreation Center is a supporter and offers sports facilities in Valgamaa, 11 km from Otepää. The competitions will take place on June 17, 2026, at Tartu Kalev Stadium, registration is open, and participants can obtain results and compete in various distances.

name: Võru kergejõustikuõhtu
location: Võru Staadion, Võru, Võru County, Estonia
description: The Võru Athletics Evening Series is a traditional athletics event series that combines stadium races, throws, and jumps competitions. Each evening consists of one throwing and one jumping discipline, as well as running distances, providing a diverse athletics experience. The competitions take place at Võru Stadium and use the IAAF points table for ranking. The series includes five stages, one of which is the Võru County Championships. Participants are required to register separately for each stage, and the bib number is valid throughout the season.
course_highlights: Various athletics disciplines held at Võru Stadium
Each evening includes throwing, jumping, and running competitions
The series uses the IAAF points table for ranking
additional: Registration opens on May 28. Separate registration is required for each stage. The bib number is valid throughout the season and is recommended to be left with the organizer at the end of each stage. Registration for throwing and jumping disciplines usually closes around 16:30-16:45, and for running events around 18:30-18:45. The competition schedule includes exact registration and start times. The last stage of the series is on August 3. Awards are given at the end of the season. Multiple stages include races, throws, and jumps, with registration according to each stage. The event is part of the Võru sports calendar and invites all sports enthusiasts to participate.

name: Valgamaa lahtised MV
description: The Valgamaa open Estonian Orienteering Sprint Championship is an orienteering competition held in the Valga region. The event is part of the RMK Estonian Orienteering Day events, which are community events without age restrictions. The courses are designed so that they can be completed by participants of different skill levels, and competitors can choose a pace that suits them. Timing is used during the event, and it is possible to rent an SI-pulse to assist with orienteering. The event is intended for everyone who wants to enjoy moving in nature and orienteering in good company.
course_highlights: Orienteering sprint in the Valga region
Courses suitable for participants of different skill levels
Option to rent an SI-pulse and use a compass
additional: The competition is part of the RMK Estonian Orienteering Day events, which are community events without age restrictions. Participants are advised to come in sportswear and bring a compass and SI-pulse, which can be rented if needed. Timing is used, but competing is not mandatory, emphasizing enjoyment of moving in nature and choosing a suitable pace. Participants have the opportunity to take part in different distances and enjoy Estonian nature and sports. The competitions are open to various age groups and offer diverse sporting experiences.

name: Narva Linna Jooks
description: Narva City Run is the largest sports event in Ida-Virumaa, encouraging people to engage in physical activity and showcasing the region in the field of Estonian culture and sports. The beautiful route through the historic border town attracts participants from Narva, other parts of Virumaa, across Estonia, and abroad. The event takes place near the Joaoru beach house and recreation area and offers a diverse and engaging running experience.
course_highlights: Beautiful route in the border town of Narva
Organized as the largest sports event in Ida-Virumaa
Participants from local areas and abroad
additional: The event takes place on June 5, 2026, starting at 17:30 near the Joaoru beach house and recreation area at Linnuse tn 2, 20308 Narva. The participation fee is 25 euros and includes various distances and a children's run. The route passes through beautiful sites in Narva, and the event is part of the Ida-Virumaa sports events series.

name: Jaanikese jooksukross
location: Jaanikese Moto- ja Vabaajakeskus, Jaanikese, Tartu County, Estonia
description: Jaanikese Running Race is the second stage of the running series held at Jaanikese Moto and Leisure Center. The course features diverse terrain suitable for both amateurs and experienced runners. The event offers an opportunity to enjoy a sporting competition in beautiful nature and is part of the active running and cycling trail at the center.
course_highlights: Diverse running track on the territory of Jaanikese Moto and Leisure Center
Additional trail for hiking, cycling, and running
Beautiful natural views and varied terrain
additional: The running race is part of the running and cycling trail at Jaanikese Moto and Leisure Center, which also includes a hiking trail and disc golf options. The center has a history room and a café open on training days. The event is organized by Valga Sports and is part of a larger sports event where participants can also enjoy activities such as motocross and disc golf.

name: Narva Linna Jooks - 5 km ja 21,1 km
description: Narva City Run is the largest mass participation event in Ida-Virumaa, taking place on June 5th and 6th at Joaorg in Narva. The event spans two days, with a mile run around the Town Hall Square on Friday and main races, including 5 km and 21.1 km distances, on Saturday. This year's course is flatter, allowing for better times, and the race is also part of the Estonian national championships in road mile running. The Narva City Run attracts thousands of amateur and elite athletes, offering a great mass participation experience.
course_highlights: Flat course allows for better times
Mile run around Town Hall Square on Friday
Main races of 5 km and 21.1 km on Saturday
additional: The race center is located at Town Hall Square. The mile run takes place around Town Hall Square on Friday, with the start and finish at the square's edge. The Narva City Run is also part of the Estonian national championships in road mile running. The two-day program features a well-planned course with sights to see, with over 3000 participants. Participation fees were not specified.

name: Ida-Virumaa staadioniultra
location: Kohtla-Nõmme Kooli staadion, Kohtla-Nõmme, Ida-Virumaa, Estonia
description: The 5th Kohtla-Nõmme Stadium Ultra, also known as the 6th Ida-Viru County Stadium Ultra, is an ultramarathon held at the Kohtla-Nõmme School stadium. The race starts on June 6th at 12:00 PM and lasts until noon on June 7th, offering participants the opportunity to test their endurance and running ability over an extended period. Organized by MTÜ Gurmeejooksud, the event invites all running enthusiasts to participate and enjoy a sporting experience.
course_highlights: Race takes place at the Kohtla-Nõmme School stadium
The competition lasts 24 hours, from noon on June 6th to noon on June 7th
A well-known ultrarunning event in the Ida-Viru region
additional: The race begins on June 6th at 12:00 PM and continues until noon on June 7th (24 hours). Organized by MTÜ Gurmeejooksud. The event is held at the Kohtla-Nõmme School stadium located at Kooli tn 6, Kohtla-Nõmme, Ida-Viru County. The stadium features ultramarathon, 308-meter laps, 12-hour results, and is part of the Estonian championships.

name: Luhamaa piirijooks
description: Luhamaa border run is part of the Võrumaa running and walking series, offering a variety of distances for both runners and walkers. The main distance runs on asphalt around the Luhamaa village hall and is approximately 5.9 km long. Additionally, there are shorter mini distances and children's runs suitable for participants of all ages. The series aims to provide a sporty and friendly competition experience in the beautiful nature of Võrumaa.
course_highlights: The main distance runs on asphalt around the Luhamaa village hall
Mini distances and children's runs are suitable for beginners and children
The track is mostly asphalted, ideal for fast running
additional: The track is entirely on asphalt. Children's runs take place in the Central Park and around EWERS in Väimela. The race is part of the 12-stage Võrumaa running and walking series, which features different distances and walking options. Participation fees and registration information, transportation arrangements, and the route partly passes through areas inaccessible to the general public at other times.

name: Padise liigub
location: Lääne-Harju Kultuurikeskus Padise rahvamaja, Padise, Lääne-Harju, Estonia
description: Padise Run is part of the Lääne-Harju Movement Series, which takes place at the Lääne-Harju Cultural Center in Padise. The course runs through the beautiful landscape of Padise, offering excitement and visual delight for runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers. The event is suitable for the whole family, with a main distance of 5 km and children's races. It is a great opportunity to enjoy physical activity in a historic and scenic environment.
course_highlights: The course runs through the beautiful landscape of Padise
Suitable for runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers
In addition to the 5 km main distance, there are children's races
additional: The competition center opens at 10:00, number pickup and registration take place before the start. Children's races begin at 11:00, warm-up exercises at 11:45, the main race starts at 12:00. Awards ceremony at 12:50 and the finish line closes at 13:15. The route is scenic and suitable for all levels; registration is on the day of the event from 10:00; the event also includes children's races and the 5 km main distance.

name: Jaanikese jooksukross
description: The II Jaanikese Running Cross will take place on June 6, 2026, at the Jaanikese Moto and Leisure Center and is part of the Valgamaa Running and Walking Series named after Rein Leppik. The event features several distances, including children's runs, a 2.7 km run and walk, and a main run of 5.4 km. The courses run along the cross-country trail, and participants will have the opportunity to enjoy a sporting event across different age groups. The organizer is the Valgamaa Sports Union, which invites all running enthusiasts to participate and enjoy an active day.
course_highlights: Runs take place on the Jaanikese cross-country trail
Multiple distances from children's runs to the 5.4 km main run
The competition is held on a cross-country trail with varied terrain
additional: Pre-registration is available online at www.timesport.ee, with additional registration at the start area from 10:30 AM. Electronic timing is available for participants from the age groups born in 2019-2020. Awards will be given to all age groups, with prizes for the top three in the overall 5.4 km main run. Participation in children's runs is free. The event takes place on June 6, 2026, and is open to all running enthusiasts, offering an opportunity to enjoy nature and engage in health sports.

name: SunRun
description: SunRun Saaremaa 2026 is a team-based experience run taking place in the beautiful nature of Saaremaa. The run starts at sunrise from Kuressaare and ends at sunset on Illiku Island in Orissaare, covering a total of 180 km. All collectives, groups of friends, and sports clubs are welcome to participate, forming a team and sharing the distance among themselves. The goal of the run is not to win, but to run comfortably and enjoyably with friends. Each participant receives a GPS bracelet that acts as a relay baton, and there are water stations and refreshments along the route.
course_highlights: 180 km long route from Kuressaare to Orissaare
15 stages where the GPS bracelet acts as a relay baton
Beautiful running paths and coastal scenery in Saaremaa
additional: The run starts on June 6 at 4:30 AM from Kuressaare Wow Center. Each team receives a GPS bracelet, which must be handed over to the next runner at freely chosen points. There are water stations, occasional hot soup, tea and bread, and the possibility to wash at the finish. The finish line is on Illiku Island, where a summer starting celebration takes place. Changing runners on the route is prohibited. Support vehicles must follow Estonian traffic rules. The route includes Saaremaa landscapes and coastlines; registration requires the use of a GPS device and running kit; the event takes place on June 6, 2026, starting from Kuressaare at 4:30 AM.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 24. Laekvere – Simuna jooks
description: The third stage of the 2026 West-Viru County running and walking series is the traditional Simuna-Laekvere run, which has secured a firm place in runners' calendars and hearts. The run is unique in that the direction of the race changes every year. The event takes place at Simuna School and invites all running enthusiasts to participate.
course_highlights: Traditional Simuna-Laekvere run
Race direction changes every year
Location at Simuna School
additional: The competition takes place at Simuna School and is part of several running events in West-Viru County, offering various distance options and age categories. Registration is conducted online, and all participants have the opportunity to receive awards.

name: E-Lux Peetri Jooks
location: Peetri, Rae Parish, Harju County, Estonia
description: E-LUX Peetri Jooks is one of Estonia's most lively mass participation events, bringing together running enthusiasts of all ages and abilities. The main distance is 10 km, where timing and awards for the best are provided, but there is also a charity run, youth run, and children's runs. The event takes place in Peetri and also features a large expo and marketplace area with various vendors and entertainment. The charity run supports the Children's Fund of Tartu University Hospital and helps children with movement disabilities. All finishers receive an awesome summer medal.
course_highlights: 10 km main run with timing and awards
5 km charity run and walk with timing and awards
Children's runs of 300 m and 1 km, no timing
additional: Virtual run allows participants to choose the distance, time, and location themselves, and medals and gift pack products are sent to virtual runners via parcel locker. No timing or rankings are kept for children's runs; everyone is a winner. The event also features a large expo and marketplace area with crafts, farm products, sweets, sports equipment, and a children's zone. Volunteers are offered hot meals and snacks. The event includes an exhibition and community gathering, medals for finishers, and various categories for all age groups.

name: Simuna-Laekvere rahvajooks
description: The Simuna-Laekvere Community Run is a traditional amateur running race held alternately between Simuna and Laekvere every other year. name: Kopli Liinide Jooks
description:
The route starts at Kopli Rail Promenade. The journey continues through Kopli Cheese Park, then along the seaside.

The first half of the route runs along the seaside, offering beautiful views of Kopli Bay.

The route also passes through the Paljassaare protected area, which is a beautiful nature reserve and a well-known birdwatching spot. Afterwards, we move through the territory of Tallinn Water, where you can see how water purification takes place before returning to the promenade.
